description: Preregistered climate-facing conditioning witness for the two-layer EBM recovery objective. It measures SVD rank/2-norm conditioning on the existing recovery Jacobian, verifies scale invariance, contrasts transient identifiability with equilibrium structural rank deficiency, and exercises a deliberately near-collinear numerical rejection control without assigning physical meaning to any conditioning threshold.

near_collinear_control.construction: Replace the declared recovery Jacobian column for replaced_parameter_id by source_parameter_id column + retained_original_multiplier * original replaced_parameter_id column. This is a synthetic numerical control, not a physical parameter relation.

verification_policy.interpretation: Used only to verify that a finite full-rank matrix above an explicit caller threshold is rejected separately from rank deficiency. It is not an empirical, climate, tipping, calibration, or universal solver threshold.

interpretation_boundary: Conditioning is a numerical property of the declared coordinates and observation map. This experiment does not infer physical instability, tipping proximity, identifiability beyond the declared local model, or a universal acceptance threshold from a condition number.
